main.description: List moderation actions with private administrative context for authorized administrators. Instance authority and actor identity come from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

parameters.description: Optional administrative moderation action filters and pagination controls

limit.description: Maximum number of administrative actions to return

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response

subject.description: Return actions for this subject AT-URI

collection.description: Return actions whose subject URI uses this collection NSID

action.description: Return actions with this moderation transition

origin.description: Return actions with this local or inherited origin

authority.description: Return actions issued by this authority DID or handle

actor.description: Return actions performed by this actor DID or handle

community.description: Community DID, handle, bare name, or name@origin resolved by the community resolver

actionId.description: Opaque service-local action identifier for exact lookup

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an authorized service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor lacks permission; do not retry unless its moderation authority changes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter or range is invalid; correct the request before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or expired; restart pagination without a cursor.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

output.description: Page of moderation actions with private administrative context

actions.description: Administrative moderation actions in server-defined order

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent at the end of pagination
